verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs include a page titled "Send events directly to mParticle" and an HTTP APIs section (/developers/apis/http/), which points to a server-side event ingestion path. The evidence is only page titles, though, with no content on endpoints, authentication, or delivery guarantees. Missing for 10: documented server-to-server HTTP event API details, authentication mechanism (keys/secrets), delivery guarantees such as retries, acknowledgements or batching semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
